value.rationale: The motivated question is whether a single rank threshold or any finite collection of thresholds controls the sign of resetting benefit in heterogeneous multiparticle search. The theorem proves no uniform finite bound even without interactions, gives an explicit universal one-distance sensitivity kernel, and constructs arbitrarily many alternating measurable quantile bands. It is not an arbitrary finite invariant or a numerical recomputation.
